svg.title: Yono 行楷字形研究 03 · 字形母版
svg.desc: Yono original hard-pen semi-running glyph study. All specimen glyphs are editable filled vector outlines. Annotation text uses system fonts. This is a design study, not a complete font.
svg.text: 每个字形均为独立矢量轮廓；浅灰线标示字面、基线及 advance。
轮廓源：designs/xingkai/glyphs.ts · 100-unit em · 不使用随机扰动
